gloss: all; any of them; both; each

definitions.gloss: all; any of them; both; each one
definitions.explanation: Refers to every item or person in a group without exception. Used to make a statement that applies equally to all members of a set.

examples.japanese: いずれも{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{作品|さくひん}だ。
{候補者|こうほしゃ}はいずれも{経験|けいけん}{豊富|ほうふ}だった。
examples.english: The candidates were all highly experienced.

examples.japanese: {三|みっ}つの{案|あん}を{検討|けんとう}したが、いずれも{一長一短|いっちょういったん}があった。
examples.english: We examined three proposals, but each had its pros and cons.

notes:
いずれも means "all of them" or "in every case," referring to each item in a group without exception. A somewhat formal word common in written Japanese, news, and formal speech.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- いずれも〜だ: all of them are ~
- いずれも〜ない: none of them ~
- いずれも{同|おな}じ: all the same

REGISTER:
More formal than the everyday equivalents. Preferred in news, academic writing, and business contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- どれも: all of them (casual, 3+ items)
- どちらも: both of them (casual, 2 items)
- いずれも: all/both (formal, works for 2 or more)
- すべて: everything, all (neutral register)

RELATED WORDS:
- いずれ: eventually, someday; which one (formal)
- いずれにしても: in any case, either way
